ghus_organization_details_on_pointer.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ghus_organization_details_on_pointer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    PERFORM ghus_organization_details_refresh(NEW.organization_id, NEW.fact_key);
    RETURN NULL;
END $function$

ghus_organization_details_refresh.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ghus_organization_details_refresh(p_organization uuid, p_key text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_value jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- 790: only the fact columns moved from organization_details are written here.
    IF NOT p_key = ANY (ARRAY[
            'primary_technical_focus',
            'technical_approach',
            'current_activities',
            'funding_summary',
            'location',
            'why_matched',
            'recent_activity',
            'funding_signal',
            'international_connection',
            'um6p_ocp_connection',
            'current_initiative',
            'current_initiative_working_group',
            'current_project',
            'pilot_customer_evidence',
            'relevant_program',
            'topic_unit_and_work',
            'institution_control',
            'land_grant_designation',
            'rankings',
            'relevant_centers_programs',
            'parent_and_center_type',
            'topic_research_focus',
            'active_recent_projects',
            'main_funders',
            'sponsoring_agency',
            'formal_national_designation',
            'topic_program_area',
            'facility_type_operator',
            'testing_demonstration_scope',
            'clinical_research_focus',
            'parent_academic_link',
            'hospital_type_scale',
            'ownership_and_size',
            'topic_business_segment_product',
            'mapped_geography_operations',
            'technology_and_problem',
            'founding_year_location',
            'funding_stage',
            'platform_type_operator',
            'sector_focus',
            'platform_offerings',
            'scale_indicator',
            'investor_type_headquarters',
            'sector_stage_focus',
            'geographic_focus',
            'published_fund_size',
            'topic_investment_thesis',
            'jurisdiction_parent_agency',
            'topic_mandate_program',
            'visible_funding_programs',
            'mission_sector_focus',
            'programs_grant_themes',
            'association_type',
            'sector_geographic_scope',
            'member_types',
            'linked_members',
            'network_scope_locations',
            'official_identity',
            'parent_connection',
            'sector_topic',
            'hub_assignment',
            'organization_category_type']) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    SELECT CASE WHEN f.collection_state = 'found' THEN f.fact_value
                ELSE to_jsonb(f.collection_state) END
      INTO v_value
      FROM organization_fact f
     WHERE f.organization_id = p_organization AND f.fact_key = p_key
       AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_fact_current_pointer p
                     WHERE p.organization_fact_id = f.organization_fact_id)
            OR (f.topic_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM organization_fact_current c
                     WHERE c.organization_fact_id = f.organization_fact_id
                       AND c.resolution_state = 'accepted')))
     ORDER BY (f.collection_state = 'found') DESC, f.retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,
              f.created_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    EXECUTE format('UPDATE public.organization SET %I = $1 WHERE organization_id = $2', p_key)
    USING v_value, p_organization;
END $function$

ghus_prevent_organization_family_cycle.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ghus_prevent_organization_family_cycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE cycle_found boolean;
BEGIN
    IF NEW.relationship_type NOT IN ('unit_of','operated_by') THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(organization_id,path) AS (
        SELECT NEW.object_id,ARRAY[NEW.object_id]
        UNION ALL
        SELECT edge.object_id,ancestors.path || edge.object_id
        FROM ancestors
        JOIN entity_edge edge
          ON edge.subject_type='actor' AND edge.object_type='actor'
         AND edge.subject_id=ancestors.organization_id
         AND edge.relationship_type IN ('unit_of','operated_by')
        WHERE NOT edge.object_id=ANY(ancestors.path)
    )
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE organization_id=NEW.subject_id)
    INTO cycle_found;
    IF cycle_found THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'organization family cycle refused for % -> %',NEW.subject_id,NEW.object_id;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
